title: C: Simple Calculator
description: Create a calculator that takes two numbers and an operator (+, -, *, /) and prints the result using a switch statement.

steps.title: Switch Calculator
steps.description: Declare `int a = 20, b = 5` and `char op = '/'`. Use a switch statement to perform the operation and print the result. Handle division by printing 'Cannot divide by zero' if b is 0.
hints: Each case should compute and print the result.
Add a `default` case for invalid operators.

verification.failureMessage: Perform the operation and print the result
